dialogue.content: こんばんは本日は宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: こんばんは　相談員です本日は宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: よろしくおねがいします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: では最初に、年齢と性別を教えて下さい
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 30代、女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 生きていくのに疲れました
dialogue.English: I'm tired of living.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねお辛いですねいつごろからそのように感じていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds very painful. How long have you been feeling this way?

dialogue.content: いつからなのかな、気づいたら
dialogue.English: I'm not sure when it started. I just realized it at some point.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね比較的最近でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Would you say it's been relatively recent?

dialogue.content: いつからなのか分かりません
dialogue.English: I don't know when it started.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね生きていくのに疲れたと感じるようになったのには、何かきっかけは思い当たりますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Can you think of any specific event that might have triggered this feeling of being tired of living?

dialogue.content: きっかけというか、、、夫が家事や子育てをしてくれなくて、ぜんぶ私
dialogue.English: Not so much a trigger... My husband doesn't help with housework or childcare—it's all on me.

dialogue.content: つかれた
dialogue.English: I'm exhausted.

dialogue.content: 夫さんが家事や育児を手伝ってくれないのですねそれは精神的にも体力的にも辛いですよね
dialogue.English: So your husband doesn't help with housework or childcare. That must be exhausting, both mentally and physically.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 家族構成をお伺いしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: May I ask about your family composition?

dialogue.content: 夫、息子2人の4人です
dialogue.English: There are four of us: my husband, our two sons, and me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます４人家族なのですね息子さんたちは、おいくつですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So it's a family of four. How old are your sons?

dialogue.content: 年中と年長です
dialogue.English: They're in the middle and senior years of kindergarten.

dialogue.content: 年中さんと年長さんなのですねお子さんたちはどのような性格ですか？
dialogue.English: Middle and senior years of kindergarten, I see. What are their personalities like?

dialogue.content: 性格聞いてどうするんですか？
dialogue.English: Why do you need to ask about their personalities?

dialogue.content: 普通です。
dialogue.English: They're normal.

dialogue.content: ご相談の参考になるかと思い、お伺いしました
dialogue.English: I asked because I thought it might be helpful for our session.

dialogue.content: お子さんたちの年齢からして、可愛いけれど、なかなか手のかかるころですよね
dialogue.English: Given their ages, they must be cute, but also quite a handful, right?

dialogue.content: まいにち怒鳴りっぱなしです。とにかくつかれた。
dialogue.English: I'm yelling at them every day. I'm just so tired.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいのか、、
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね怒鳴ることが多くなってしまうのは、相談者さんご自身にとってストレスになりますよね
dialogue.English: I see. Yelling so often must be stressful for you as well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夫さんはお仕事からは何時頃になることが多いのですか？
dialogue.English: Around what time does your husband usually get home from work?

dialogue.content: だいたい19時くらいまでには帰ってきます。
dialogue.English: He usually gets home by around 7 p.m.

dialogue.content: 19時くらいなのですね夫さんはお子さんたちとは、どのように接していらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Around 7 p.m., I see. How does your husband interact with the children?

dialogue.content: 自分がかまいたい時だけって感じです
dialogue.English: It feels like it's only when he feels like it.

dialogue.content: 夫は自分が1番なので
dialogue.English: My husband always puts himself first.

dialogue.content: なるほどそうなのですね家事と育児のほとんどを、相談者さんが負担している、という感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. So it sounds like you're shouldering most of the housework and childcare. Is that right?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: それは毎日忙しい中、本当に頑張っていらっしゃいますよね
dialogue.English: You're truly working so hard every day amidst all that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんはお仕事をされているのですか？
dialogue.English: Are you working as well?

dialogue.content: してます
dialogue.English: I am.

dialogue.content: パートですが、仕事も家事も育児もつかれました
dialogue.English: It's part-time, but I'm exhausted from work, housework, and childcare.

dialogue.content: お仕事、家事、育児、頭が下がりますなかなかできることではないと思います
dialogue.English: Work, housework, and childcare... I have so much respect for you. I don't think many people could manage all of that.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんがとても疲れていることを、夫さんとお話しされたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever talked to your husband about how exhausted you are?

dialogue.content: ありますよ、いつも言ってます。もっとやって欲しいって。でも全く変わりません。
dialogue.English: Yes, I have. I tell him all the time that I want him to do more, but nothing ever changes.

dialogue.content: 追求すると喧嘩になるので余計疲れます。
dialogue.English: If I press the issue, it just turns into a fight, which makes me even more tired.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですねそれは不満もたまりますよね夫さんが変わらないのは、なぜだと思われますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must build up a lot of frustration. Why do you think your husband doesn't change?

dialogue.content: 夫はもともと亭主関白の家庭で育ったので、家事は女がやる事だと思ってるからだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it's because he was raised in a very traditional, patriarchal family, so he believes housework is a woman's job.

dialogue.content: なるほど相談者さんはそのように思われるのですね相談者さんは、家事や育児の負担にはどのようにお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, that's what you think. What are your thoughts on the burden of housework and childcare?

dialogue.content: 負担でしかないです
dialogue.English: It's nothing but a burden.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねご夫婦で協力し合って、分担するもの、と思われますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Do you think it should be something you and your husband cooperate on and share?

dialogue.content: はい、もっと夫に協力して欲しいです
dialogue.English: Yes, I want my husband to cooperate more.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねここまでのお話しを少し整理してみますね
dialogue.English: I see. Let me try to summarize what we've talked about so far.

dialogue.content: どうぞ
dialogue.English: Please, go ahead.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんは、夫さんにも家事や育児を分担して協力して欲しいと思っている実際には夫さんは、おそらく家事や育児などは女性がするものだと思っており、手伝ってくれない
dialogue.English: You want your husband to cooperate and share the housework and childcare. However, in reality, your husband probably believes that housework and childcare are things women should do, so he doesn't help.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 話し合いをしても変わってくれないその状況に、相談者さんはお仕事にも家事や育児にもとても疲れを感じている、ということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Even when you try to talk to him, he doesn't change. Because of this situation, you're feeling exhausted from your job, housework, and childcare. Is that an accurate summary?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますでは、相談者さんとしては、今一番ご相談になりたいことは何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you most like to focus on today?

dialogue.content: 1番と言われてもなんて答えたらいいかぴんとこなくて
dialogue.English: When you say 'the main thing,' I'm not sure how to answer; it doesn't quite click for me.

dialogue.content: そうですねでは、どうなると、相談者さんが少しでも楽なお気持ちになると思いますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. In that case, what do you think would help you feel even a little bit more at ease?

dialogue.content: 前にも言ったように、夫にもっと協力して欲しいと思ってます。
dialogue.English: As I've said before, I want my husband to cooperate more.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね夫さんはどうすれば協力してくれるようになると思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. What do you think might lead him to become more cooperative?

dialogue.content: わかりません、だから相談しにきたんで
dialogue.English: I don't know. That's why I came here for counseling.

dialogue.content: そうですね人の性格は簡単に変わるものではないので、難しいですよね例えばですが、パートを減らすなどは難しそうですか？
dialogue.English: You're right, it's difficult to change someone's personality. For example, would it be difficult to reduce your part-time hours?

dialogue.content: 私がパートを減らしたらお前は楽してるんだから家事もちゃんとやれって流れになると思います。
dialogue.English: If I reduced my hours, I think it would turn into, “You're taking it easy now, so you should do the housework properly.”

dialogue.content: なるほどそのように思われるのですね思い切って、一度やめてみられるのも一つの手かと思いますが、どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, that's what you're concerned would happen. Taking the plunge and quitting your job for a while might be one option. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: こどもが幼稚園に行くようになってやっと仕事復帰できたんです。それでもやっぱ私が仕事辞めるのが1番いいんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I was finally able to return to work now that the kids are in kindergarten. Is quitting my job really the best option?

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね復帰されたばかりなのですね仕事も家事も育児も、全てを完璧に行う必要はないと思いますし、そうなったとしても、それは相談者さんが悪いのではなく、協力してくれない夫さんの責任だと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, so you just recently returned to work. I don't think you need to do your job, housework, and childcare perfectly. And even if things aren't perfect, I believe it's not your fault, but rather the responsibility of your husband for not cooperating. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう時間ですね
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is up.

dialogue.content: そうですねまたいつでもご相談にいらして下さい
dialogue.English: Yes, it is. Please feel free to come back for a consultation anytime.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (相談者役、お疲れ様でした)
dialogue.English: (Good job playing the role of the client.)

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイありがとうございました。カウンセラー役お疲れ様でした！)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play. Good work playing the counselor!)
